strategy_rationale: Ensemble quant system combining tsmom_volscaled, ml_crypto_pred, growth_stock_screener, and commodity_carry_momo engines with 8-gate statistical validation. CRYPTO signals are strongest (n sufficient, gates pass). EQUITY signals are weaker (n=20, small sample — use 1/3-1/4 sizing). COMMODITY is borderline (n~58, concentration risk). All picks are market-supported; no signals generated for classes failing gate metrics. Primary failure mode: CRYPTO vulnerable to low-quality volume and regime shifts invalidating short-horizon ML signals. EQUITY unstable due to tiny sample. COMMODITY at risk from concentration. Kill condition: rolling 50-trade PF < 1.0 or WR < 45% for any asset class.

failure_modes.CRYPTO: Low-quality volume data; regime shifts invalidate short-horizon ML signals
failure_modes.EQUITY: Tiny sample size (n=20) makes backtest statistics unreliable; gap risk on micro-cap names
failure_modes.COMMODITY: Borderline sample (n~58) with concentration risk from single-contract signals; contango/backwardation estimation errors
failure_modes.kill_condition: Rolling 50-trade PF < 1.0 or WR < 45% for any asset class
